Author: XeldarAlz
Name: Aetherphone Development
Punchline: An in-game smartphone with social apps, messaging and game tools.
Description: An in-game smartphone for FINAL FANTASY XIV with 42 apps. Chirper, Aethergram, Velvet (18+), ChocoChat messaging and voice calls run on the Aethernet online service, which you sign in to with your character. Other apps cover game chat, the market board, hunts, timers, maps and more, plus music, video and an arcade of games.
